Name: Queen Miraset
Description: One of the human women abducted by the H'San Natall for the sake an alien/human crossbreading program. After giving birth to Prysm (who would go on to join the Teen Titans ) Queen Miraset chose to betray the the human race, and remained with the H'San Natall, eventually becoming their queen.
